text:
maria: Heads up — opened a bulk-edit PR to regenerate all Optimize toolkit examples that reference batching/cache/quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 please skim.
kevin: :eyes: thanks, will take a look after stand. main changes?
maria: Mostly automated sample regen + a new migration note for SDK <v0.8 (calls to BatchConfig changed). Also tightened the quant-profile table (removed obsolete 8-bit preset).
sam: Can you paste the updated snippets? quick glance pls.
maria: Sure — here's the main Python update: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...", batch_config={"max_batch_tokens": 512, "latency_target_ms": 120})
```
maria: Old code used batch_size param, new SDK uses batch_config.
olivia: Go snippet?
maria: Go update: ```go
cli := redwood.New()
req := redwood.GenerateRequest{Prompt: "Summarize...", BatchConfig: map[string]interface{}{"max_batch_tokens":512}}
res, _ := cli.Generate(req)
```
kevin: Looks straightforward. Two things: 1) can we add a short migration callout in the sidebar? 2) CI is failing on mkdocs lint in the new table formatting.
maria: Added a short migration note under /optimize/migration.md and linked it in the sidebar draft. For CI lint I pushed a commit fixing the markdown table.
sam: QA checklist — who can smoke test examples on staging? I can run examples with the dedicated runtime image tomorrow.
maria: Awesome, thanks. Steps I ran locally: `yarn docs:regen-examples --filter optimize --out tmp/examples` then `make docs-serve`. I also ran `python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` and `mkdocs build` to catch mkdocs warnings.
kevin: Assigning reviewers: @kevin (runtime), @olivia (sdk/examples), @sam (qa). Please add :shipit: or :x: with short reason on the PR.
docs-bot: CI: mkdocs-lint failed on commit 3a9f2b — details: https://ci.redwood-infra/internal/4821/checks/5
maria: Fixed and force-pushed. Also added a tiny note about quant-profile rationale (why we dropped the 8-bit preset for Llama2-13B under high-latency workloads).
olivia: One question — should we provide a migration helper snippet for teams still on v0.7? a small shim: ```python
# shim for v0.7 -> v0.8
if sdk_version.startswith('0.7'):
    # translate old batch_size to new batch_config
    params['batch_config'] = {"max_batch_tokens": params.pop('batch_size', 128) * 8}
```
kevin: Hmm I'd rather we document the mapping and avoid shipping shims in docs. but include the small snippet in migration.md as an optional utility.
sam: Staging run successful for my test set — batching behavior looks right and KV prefetch example still passes. I hit one minor output formatting mismatch due to different tokenizer behavior; left a comment on the PR.
maria: Thanks — responded to that comment with an updated expected output. Anything preventing merge?
kevin: Hold for 24 hours for Olivia to review the SDK wording. after that, go ahead. :+1:
olivia: Reviewing now. small nits on phrasing and an extra link; will resolve in a follow-up commit.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview-4821--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration.html (staging)
maria: Great, once olivia approves I'll squash and merge. Will also file a short ticket to update any recorded samples in the example corpus (xref #2334).
kevin: Thanks for doing the bulk regen — this should reduce future drift. :tada:
maria: Appreciate the help. If anyone wants to test different quant profiles I left a tiny script in /scripts/optkit/compare_profiles.sh — use `./compare_profiles.sh Llama2-13B q8 q4` to run quick diffs.
sam: Saved. I'll run a sweep next week across low-latency configs.
maria: Closing loop — PR merged after OLIVIA approved and CI green. Will follow up if we need to backport to the 0.7 docs branch.
